items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns.

Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia.

---------------------------------------------------------------

Registration is open to all, of all nationalities.

Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few.

Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. If there aren't three competitors from Bahia with valid results in an event, other competitors will be eligible to receive prizes, respecting the preference of competitors from Bahia.

items.information:
**English:**
CubingAT is happy to announce the first official WCA competition in Salzburg, the Salzburg Open 2020. Fortunately, we found a very strong, dynamic and cool partner (HTBLuVA Salzburg), that finally gave us the possibility to solve some cubes in Salzburg.
The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations.

All guests are welcome, but to maintain the security, we would like you to let us know you’re coming. Simply write us your name to this e-mail address: competitions@cubing.at. Alternatively, if you accompany a competitor, they can write your name in the comment of their registration.
___
**Deutsch:**
Wir von CubingAT freuen uns sehr euch in der HTBLuVA Salzburg, bei den ersten Salzburg Open 2020 begrüßen zu können. Dank der hervorragenden Zusammenarbeit mit dem routinierten, dynamischen und vor allem aufgeschlossenen Team der HTBLuVA, dürfen wir Speedcuber auch endlich mal in Salzburg Würfel (schnell) lösen. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben.

Alle Gäste sind selbstverständlich gerne willkommen, jedoch würden wir euch aus Sicherheitsgründen bitten, uns ein kurzes Mail mit eurem Namen unter der E-Mail competitions@cubing.at zukommen zu lassen. Oder, falls Ihr einen Teilnehmer begleitet, kann Euer Name bei dessen Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld vermerkt werden.

items.name: GLS Gdynia 2020
items.information:
This is final competition of GLS Cup 2019 series. During winners ceremony we will reward 5 top speedcubers from various [GLS classifications](https://www.speedcubing.pl/gdanska-liga-2019/klasyfikacje-ligowe).
GLS Cup 2019 is a series of 5 official WCA competitions in Gdańsk and Gdynia. GLS is combining 5 competitions into one ranking system including:
- General classification of all events
- 3x3x3 classification for kids,
- 3x3x3 for parents 
- 3x3x3 Fewest Moves League
At the main venue we have big rollup banner with the names of [GLS Record](https://www.speedcubing.pl/gdanska-liga-2019/rekordy-gls) holders. It is our tradition to refresh the names after each record. After the first day we host cubers integration. Next to the hotel we have parking area and shops.
If you want to join us, you are most welcome!

items.information:
Español: La competencia Montevideo Palace 2019 será la tercera edición que se llevará acabo en este local.
Leer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
Ésta competencia esta abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad, a nuevos y viejos competidores y sin importar los tiempos de resolución.
Los acompañantes de los competidores no tiene que pagar ningún tipo de entrada ni inscripción.
Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento, de acuerdo al artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. Por favor tengan también en cuenta los artículos [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) y [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1).

English: The Montevideo Palace 2019 competition will be the third edition that will take place in this venue.
Read the [regulations of the WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid possible issues.
This competition is open to competitors of any nationality.
Guests do not have to pay any type of entry or registration.
Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with article [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the regulation. Please also take into account articles [3a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a) and [3a1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#3a1).

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information:
2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol!
Durch Tirol zieht sich ein langes Tal, das Inntal, welches das breiteste Tal in Tirol ist, für erste Besucher aber trotzdem eng erscheinen könnte.

Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab!

______
2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol!
Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well.

The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!

items.name: SSL Final Stockholm 2019
items.information:
Det här är finaltävlingen i Swedish Speedcubing League 2019. Tävlingen är öppen för alla oavsett tidigare erfarenhet, men är begränsad till maximalt 110 deltagare. Besökare är varmt välkomna under tävlingen. Registreringen kommer att ske på denna WCA-sida och anses inte vara färdig innan vi mottagit betalningen av anmälningsavgiften som har fastställts till 200 SEK. För mer information om tävlingen, se flikarna ovan. Information om Swedish Speedcubing League finns här: https://ssl-se.webnode.se/

-----

This is the final competition of the Swedish Speedcubing League 2019. The competition is open to everyone regardless of earlier experience, but is limited to 110 competitors due to venue constraints. Visitors are very welcome during the competiton. Registration will happen on this WCA-page and is not considered complete before we have received the payment of the entry fee which has been set to 200 SEK. For more information about this competition, see the tabs. Information about the Swedish Speedcubing League can be found here: https://ssl-se.webnode.se/

items.information:
Dette er den 3. version af Tårnby Cube Træf. Udover officielle WCA dicsipliner kommer der også til at blive afholdt fire uofficielle discipliner: Kilominx, TeamBLD, re-scramble, og dodgeball cubing i løbet af weekenden. Det står i tidsskemaet, hvornår de vil foregå!

items.information:
**ESPAÑOL**
Nuevamente el Palacio de la Juventud y la Municipalidad de Los Olivos nos brindarán su apoyo para llevar a cabo este torneo de speedsolving.

Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA.

Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la [pestaña “Horario" (Schedule)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la [pestaña “Categorías” (Events)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events).

Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID.

**ENGLISH**
Once again Palacio de la Juventud and Municipalidad de Los Olivos are supporting another speedsolving competition.

The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition.

Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the [Schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events).

It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve.
Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition.
**Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.**

**REPAS** :
Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition.
Samedi soir, pour 10€ : 
* Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser)
* Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau

Dimanche soir pour 15€ : 
* Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J)
* Un dessert, comme le samedi

**LASER GAME** :
Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€.
Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! 

---
You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event.
We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition.
**Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.**

**DINNERS**:
On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue.
Saturday evening for 10€:
* "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us)
* A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake

Sunday evening for 15€:
* A big pizza (to be chosen on the day)
* A dessert, like on Saturday

**LASER GAME**:
On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€.
Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

This will be the second Copper Country Cubing (Michigan Technological University) competition, in Michigan's great Upper Peninsula. 

The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. Check the schedule to see if the events at that time will be in the second floor ballroom, first floor alumni lounge, or ground floor commons.

items.name: Reto Chignahuapan 2019
items.information:
Chignahuapan, *pueblo mágico*, es el principal productor de esferas en todo el país, bello por folklor y sus paisajes naturales como la laguna de Chignahuapan, las cascadas de Quetzalapan, las aguas termales y sus bosques. Han pasado casi 8 años desde el primer Reto Chignahuapan, es hora de traer uno nuevo y no hay otra mejor manera que con un gran torneo.

Este torneo es posible gracias al staff del ***Puebla Rubik’s Team*** y al ***Gobierno municipal de Chignahuapan.***
![](https://i.imgur.com/17KskVW.jpg)

Chignahuapan, *pueblo magico*, is the main manufacturer of Christmas spheres in Mexico. Chignahuapan is beautiful because its folklore and its natural landscapes are amazing. 8 years have passed since the first *Reto Chignahuapan*, it's time to bring a new one but in shape of 2019

This tournament is supported to ***Puebla Rubik's Team*** staff and ***Chignahuapan municipal government***

items.information:
**ESPAÑOL**
Navojoa, Sonora mejor conocida como La Perla del Mayo, es una bonita ciudad ubicada en el Sur de Sonora, rodeada de Sierra, Mar y Desierto.
La tribu Mayo habita el sur de Sonora desde hace cientos de años, entre sus tradiciones mas destacadas podemos mencionar la danza del venado que es conocida a nivel internacional. 
La competencia del **Open del Mayo 2019** se desarrollara en el **CAS del Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora** principal universidad de la region, que cuenta con comodas instalaciones que permitiran a los participantes dar sus mejores tiempos.
A menos de una hora de Navojoa se encuentra la playa de Huatabampito, El pueblo magico de Alamos y una gran variedad de atracciones turisticas de tipo rural.

**INGLES**
Navojoa, Sonora better known as the Pearl of May, is a beautiful city located in the South of Sonora, surrounded by Sierra, Sea and Desert.
The Mayo tribe inhabits southern Sonora for hundreds of years, among its most outstanding traditions we can mention the deer dance that is known internationally.
The competition del **Open del Mayo 2019** will be held at the **CAS of the Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora**, the main university in the region, which has comfortable facilities that will allow participants to give their best times.
Less than an hour from Navojoa is the beach of Huatabampito, the magical town of Alamos and a wide variety of tourist attractions of a rural type.

items.information: Otago October 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna auto-sustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Aiming to a good fluence for the competition, at registering for a event, you compromise to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

items.information:
(HR)

Croatian Nationals 2019 je trinaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. 

--------------

(EN)

Croatian Nationals 2019 is the 13th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia.  Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.

items.name: SCS1 Almaty Open Air 2019
items.information:
Летние соревнования будут проводиться на открытом воздухе на территории жилого комплекса возле Школы спидкубинга. Будут расставлены шатры защищающие участников от солнца и дождя.
На соревнования необходимо взять с собой солнцезащитный крем и головоломки, которые вы будете собирать. На территории есть детская площадка и футбольное поле, где можно будет поиграть (мячи не предоставляем).
Официальная церемония открытия состоится 20 июля 2019 года в 10:15.
За участие всем будут выданы крутые памятные медали, а за призовые места во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы и медали!

Summer competitions will be held outdoors in a residential complex near the School of speedcubing. Tents will be placed to protect participants from the sun and rain.
Please take with you sunscreen and puzzles that you are going to solve. Onsite there is a children playground and a football field where you can play (balls are not provided)
The official opening ceremony will take place on 20 July 2019 at 10:15.
For participation everyone will be given a cool commemorative medals and for taking a podium of every event there are prizes and medals!

items.information:
Every competitor MUST declare their allegiance to either Ohio State or Michigan. Please write in the comments if you would like to represent Ohio State or Michigan. If you do not pick a team, we will notify you via email until you pick one.

This event will feature a crew battle between five members of each team. The members will be selected semi-randomly based on the results of 3x3 R1. The crew battle will consist of a best 2-out-of-3, head-to-head competition. Event 1 is a mystery event. Event 2 is a 3x3 head-to-head relay. The tiebracker event is a mystery event.

The winning team will receive the $100 prize pot ($20/player) paid entirely in $2 bills.

items.name: Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019

venue.name: [Wellington College](https://www.wellington-college.school.nz/facility-hire)
venue.address: 15 Dufferin St, Mount Victoria, Wellington 6021, New Zealand

items.information:
Following the first competition in Oceania (New Zealand Championships 2009), speedcubing exploded in popularity across the continent. Now, ten years later, we're holding a competition to celebrate the growth of the community, and everything we've achieved over that period. Oceania 10th Anniversary 2019 returns to Wellington, the site of that first competition, and marks almost exactly ten years since then.
Additionally, this is the first competition of the "Cubing Down Under Tour" - a tightly scheduled series of competitions across Oceania, leading up to WCA World Championship 2019, in Melbourne. This should build hype for the World Championship, and, (especially for foreign competitors) provide an excellent opportunity to experience more of the continent. For more information, visit the [travel page](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/travel) of the World Championship website.

items.information:
Welcome to the 5th edition of the Swedish Decathlon Challenge! The competition will follow the same structure as during the last decathlons with competitors collecting points during the ten events. The competitor with most points over the competition will become the Swedish Decathlon Champion 2019. The competitors limit for this event is set to 80. More information about the Swedish Decathlon as well as more information about the competition, payment and registration can be found under the tabs above. Remember that the competition will be run just as any other WCA competition where everyone are welcome to visit and participate. The decathlon challenge is considered to be unofficial.

-----

Välkommen till den 5:e upplagan av Swedish Decatlon Challenge! Tävlingen följer samma struktur som under de senaste tävlingarna där tävlande samlar poäng under de tio grenarna. Deltagaren med flest poäng efter tävlingens slut blir tiokampsmästare 2019. Deltagargränsen för denna tävling är satt till 80. Mer information om tävlingen, betalning och registrering finns under flikarna ovan. Kom ihåg att tävlingen kommer att hållas precis som vilken annan WCA-tävling som helst där alla är välkomna att delta eller vara åskådare. Tiokampsutmaningen anses vara inofficiell.

**Попадание в финальные раунды:** Для тех дисциплин, которые имеют больше одного раунда, мы будем набирать минимальное количество участников, которые имеют белорусское гражданство. В каждый финал попадут минимум 12 белорусских участников.

**ВНИМАНИЕ:** Так как это Чемпионат Беларуси, то претендовать на призы могут только граждане Беларуси. В то же время чемпионат остаётся открытым для участия для всех национальностей.

items.name: Copa Black Horse 2019

venue.name: Policlinico de Salud San Juan
venue.address: Av Pedro Miotta & Av Ramon Vargas Machuca, San Juan de Miraflores

items.information:
**ESPAÑOL**
Este es el primer torneo patrocinado por y realizado con la ayuda de Black Horse Toys. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA.

REGISTRO:

El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro).

Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events).

Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID.

*Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con el organizador

El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el viernes 31 de mayo o hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores.

**ENGLISH**
This is the first competition sponsored by Black Horse Toys store. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition.

REGISTRATION:

A register is considered complete when electronic registration has been completed and payment has been made (registration fees and payment methods are detailed at Registration requirements section).

Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the Schedule tab. Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the Events tab.

It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

*Competitors who come from outside Lima will have to contact the organizer in order to coordinate the payment method.

Registration will stay opened till May 31 or till competitor limit is reached.

![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png)

Sacramento's seventh competition is here! Make sure to sign up to reserve your spot!

Registration fee is $20, and you are permitted to sign up for all available events. **Note: The venue for SacCubing VII 2019 is in a different location compared to previous SacCubing competitions.**

All competitors will be expected to help by judging or running for any event they are doing. Nametags will be handed out with all the information regarding what groups you will be competing in and what groups you will be helping in. If you are not competing in an event, you will not be assigned to help during that event.

All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue, supplies, etc.

items.information:
**UPDATE** (March 9): The competition has reached the 60-competitor limit, and a number of people now have registrations on the waiting list. Registration has now been closed. In the event of any cancellation, we will accept people from the waiting list in the order in which they have paid the registration fee.

STMHS is holding its first WCA competition in May! This competition is planned to help lower the costs of graduation caps and gowns for seniors in STMHS and bring some love to Connecticut cubing. (And then some!) The events consist of some NxNxN puzzles (2x2 up to 5x5, including 3x3 Blindfolded) as well as more unorthodox puzzles (Skewb, Square-1, Pyraminx). 2x2 and 3x3 will have two rounds while the rest of the events will only have one round.

Guests are welcome, though it will be appreciated to inform us on how many each competitor will plan on having with them on their registration forms. To the right of the venue is New London High School which has a free parking lot, though its capacity becoming full throughout the day is unknown.

items.information:
You’ve asked. We’ve said yes! Speedcubing is AGAIN coming to the township of Langley! Similar to last year, we look forward to a full house of 90 competitive cubers, this time on SATURDAY MAY 4th, 2019.

The lunch and snack concession is back and CAD or USD **CASH** is required at the competition for those wishing to eat on site here.

**Calling for your volunteer help**. Those previously experienced as scramblers, judges and runners willing to gift some of their time are asked to e-mail [Lindy](mailto:lindy@flefc.org) to say that **of course** you're in!

Volunteering is fun, engages you fully in the day and, with plenty of help, keeps the competition events moving along in a timely manner.  A judging tutorial will be provided just prior to the start of the day.

Anyone who volunteers- yes, parents, too- are eligible to put their name in our draw for little thank you prizes!

See you all there and we appreciate you emailing in to volunteer a portion of your day.

items.information:
3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the main event of this competition!

This is a quiet events competition. We will NOT be holding usual events like 3x3. If you are a new competitor or are in a regular competition, this probably isn't for you, and you may want to check out other local competitions. Spectators may attend for free, but you are likely to get bored very quickly as the events held are quite slow.

Other local competitions:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheBattleofLexington2019
Stay on the lookout for others as well in the coming months!

The competition will be held in Salisbury Labs 105 (SL 105), this building is across the fountain from the campus center. Parking can be found in any of the visitors lots on Institute Rd or on Boynton St.
